scope: Development, written after both controllers completed and before first outcome reading
integrity: Verify original and amended plans, all source/input/output/forecast hashes, dated sampling repair and unchanged specification, 48 updates per seed, 25088 evaluation and 1024 proposal responses per seed, restored adapters, lock timestamp before every update, original deadlines; preserve source snapshots. Intentional -15 attempt audited before forecasts/updates.
modes: Same-probe forecasts on evaluation-template questions; independent-template transfer averages calibration forecasts across eight calibration questions and compares to each evaluation question. Both evaluated after all results. Also report calibration and evaluation observed effects separately.
metrics: All seeds, rates, estimators, methods, endpoints and four styles plus pooled. Absolute RMSE/MAE/bias, predicted/actual RMS and through-origin slope/correlation, nRMSE relative to zero if actual RMS>0, per-batch median/p90/max absolute errors. Undefined ratios remain undefined. Method differences versus zero and SVD16. Finite evaluation sampling error is a noise diagnostic, not subtracted from headline errors.
uncertainty: 1000 paired hierarchical bootstrap replicates with RNG8173 per seed; batches resampled within each of four styles; calibration and evaluation questions resampled independently; per-question proposal sample indices resampled independently of evaluation sample indices. Evaluation resampling is paired across baseline and all updates/rates and proposal resampling paired across methods/rates/batches. Recompute linear and SNIS forecasts from saved per-trajectory derivatives/rewards. Pointwise95% intervals for pooled errors and MSE differences vs zero/SVD, actual and forecast mean changes. Two reused seeds/hardware, eight questions/template, finite proposal support: descriptive only, no significance or population claims.
support: Report per-question proposal event counts/ranges, independent baseline estimates, ESS minimum/median/fraction<16 by seed/rate/method/template. Flag zero sampled events and event emergence among updated generations; bootstrap cannot discover unsampled modes. Linear predicted probability levels outside[0,1] flagged, not clipped. No dropping low-ESS or rare-event cases.
quality: All 48 updates versus common independent baseline: exact tags/order, all tags present, numbered, tokens, words, truncation, empty, repeated-token/4gram flags; calibration and evaluation templates separate; all style/rate/seed results retained.
examples: Batch0..3, probe0 and8, sample0, all rates and both seeds, with baseline. No favorable-example selection.
next_phase: Choose development follow-up only from full evidence; known score-function/importance-sampling estimators are not novelty. Any confirmation needs new untouched deduplicated data, independent seeds and frozen hypothesis.
